To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have solved the crystal structure of the Taz 2 domain of p 300 and that we have shown that it is similar to the previously determined NMR structures of Taz2.
we have solved the crystal structure of a segment from the Taz2 region of p300 and have used this structure to propose a mechanism of the interaction of Taz2 with phosphorylated p53.

we determined the crystal structure of the Taz 2 domain of p 300 and that it resembles the solution structures of shorter peptides and that it provides additional insights into the recognition of TADs by Taz2 and that a hypothetical model of TAD1 binding to Taz2 was proposed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
elucidating the structural and functional properties of the Taz domain of the p300 protein.
elucidation of the structural and functional basis of the interaction of Taz2 with TADs.
the structural and functional characterization of the p300 Taz2 domain.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the structure and function of the Taz domains is not fully understood.
the crystal structure presented here provides insights into the molecular basis of Taz2 domain function and its interactions with diverse TADs.
the structure of Taz2 domain is a helical bundle stabilized with three zinc ions and closely resembles solution structures determined previously.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the structure of Taz2 provides a basis for understanding how Taz2 recognizes diverse TADs and how it may be regulated by phosphorylation.
the structure of the Taz domain of p300 is now solved and we can see how the domain binds to different TADs.
the structure of the Taz domain from p300 is a helical bundle with an unusual arrangement of the three zinc-binding residues.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the Taz2 module of p300/CBP is a highly adaptable platform for the recognition of a diverse range of TADs, and that this recognition involves the formation of multiple interactions with the peptide ligands.
the Taz2 domains of CBP and p300 are capable of binding diverse peptide sequences, including those of the transactivation domains of p53 and CREB, with similar affinities.
Taz2 is a versatile peptide-binding domain with the ability to recognize a wide spectrum of ligands, ranging from short peptides to larger proteins, by using the same basic structural elements.
